claim: Business press framed Gen Z's analog and pre-smartphone nostalgia as a commercial opportunity in April 2026.
excerpt: Summary: 13-25-year-olds long for a tech-free past ('anemoia'); analog experiences are flourishing; the social-media-blocker app market is projected at $5B by 2035 (that figure concerns apps, not physical analog goods).
title: Gen Z is engineering an analog future — and it's at least a $5 billion opportunity
